patterns.title: Django file uploads
patterns.cause: Uploaded names and generated paths can retain unsafe path components.
preconditions: Attacker controls an uploaded filename or a filename supplied to storage.
patterns.patch_observation: Validate basename and parent path components at the relevant storage and upload boundaries.
patterns.prevention: Validate basename and parent path components at the relevant storage and upload boundaries.
patterns.limitations: Patch has multiple storage/upload safeguards; basename stripping alone is not a complete fix.

fixtures.scenario: Reject parent traversal and empty/dot filenames; retain legitimate filenames.
Ordinary upload filename remains accepted.

patterns.title: Werkzeug safe_join
patterns.cause: A Windows absolute-path predicate misses a UNC-like path on older Python.
preconditions: Windows, Python <3.11, Werkzeug <3.0.6, untrusted safe_join path.
patterns.patch_observation: Reject leading slash paths in addition to existing absolute and parent checks.
patterns.prevention: Reject leading slash paths in addition to existing absolute and parent checks.
patterns.limitations: Do not report this CVE on all platforms solely because safe_join is called.

fixtures.scenario: UNC-like absolute input is rejected.
Ordinary relative child path remains accepted.

patterns.title: Django Trunc/Extract
patterns.cause: Untrusted SQL structural arguments reach date/time SQL generation.
preconditions: Untrusted kind/lookup_name on the affected Django branches.
patterns.patch_observation: Constrain structural arguments before SQL generation; application-level safe choices are an additional mitigation.
patterns.prevention: Constrain structural arguments before SQL generation; application-level safe choices are an additional mitigation.
patterns.limitations: ORM usage does not make all structural parameters safe; value binding and identifiers differ.

fixtures.scenario: Invalid structural date-part argument is rejected before execution.
Known permitted date-part choices preserve intended queries.

patterns.title: Django QuerySet.order_by
patterns.cause: A deprecated raw column alias path bypasses intended validation.
preconditions: Untrusted order_by input on affected Django 3.1/3.2 releases.
patterns.patch_observation: Restore strict column-reference checks and reject inputs that do not resolve as allowed fields.
patterns.prevention: Restore strict column-reference checks and reject inputs that do not resolve as allowed fields.
patterns.limitations: Deprecation warnings are not enforcement; main branch had removed the legacy path.

fixtures.scenario: Invalid raw column alias is rejected.
Supported field ordering still works.

patterns.title: CPython urllib.parse bracketed hosts
patterns.cause: Bracketed non-IP hosts can be interpreted inconsistently by URL parsers.
preconditions: Untrusted URL reaches multiple parsers with inconsistent host handling; SSRF is conditional.
patterns.patch_observation: Validate bracketed hosts as IPv6/IPvFuture and use consistent validated destinations at request time.
patterns.prevention: Validate bracketed hosts as IPv6/IPvFuture and use consistent validated destinations at request time.
patterns.limitations: Parser fix alone is not a complete network egress policy; redirects and destination controls remain application concerns.

fixtures.scenario: Malformed bracketed host is rejected.
Valid IPv6/IPvFuture URLs continue parsing.

patterns.title: Cookiecutter Mercurial checkout
patterns.cause: An attacker-controlled checkout value is interpreted as a Mercurial option.
preconditions: Application calls Cookiecutter with untrusted checkout and the hg backend.
patterns.patch_observation: Separate the hg option list from the checkout value with its supported end-of-options marker.
patterns.prevention: Separate the hg option list from the checkout value with its supported end-of-options marker.
patterns.limitations: Argument-list subprocess invocation without a shell does not prevent target-program option injection. Backend-specific boundary required.

fixtures.scenario: Option-like checkout is passed as an operand rather than a flag.
Ordinary branch selection preserves argument order and behavior.

patterns.title: Celery result backend exception reconstruction
patterns.cause: Result metadata selects a callable that is invoked as an exception constructor.
preconditions: Attacker can manipulate result-backend metadata and a consumer reconstructs the stored failure.
patterns.patch_observation: Require the reconstructed object to be a class derived from BaseException before invoking it.
patterns.prevention: Require the reconstructed object to be a class derived from BaseException before invoking it.
patterns.limitations: This is callable reconstruction from stored metadata, not a generic shell=True signature. Backend access is a required precondition.

fixtures.scenario: A non-exception callable selected by metadata is rejected.
Legitimate exception classes are still reconstructed.

patterns.title: BentoML HTTP entry service
patterns.cause: A public endpoint can accept a pickle media type and deserialize unsafe input.
preconditions: Untrusted request reaches the affected entry service; internal and external service boundaries differ.
patterns.patch_observation: Reject the pickle media type at the main service boundary before deserialization.
patterns.prevention: Reject the pickle media type at the main service boundary before deserialization.
patterns.limitations: Patch has an is_main guard, not a global pickle ban. No regression test file was found in this patch; runtime coverage remains pending.

fixtures.scenario: Public entry service rejects pickle media type.
Permitted JSON requests still work; internal service use needs separate trust analysis.

patterns.title: Django PostgreSQL FilteredRelation aliases
patterns.cause: Attacker controlled alias dictionaries can inject SQL through PostgreSQL column alias handling.
preconditions: Expanded alias dictionary contains untrusted PostgreSQL identifier text.
patterns.patch_observation: PostgreSQL compiler rejects dollar signs in alias names.
patterns.prevention: PostgreSQL compiler rejects dollar signs in alias names.
patterns.limitations: PostgreSQL-specific condition; alias validation must match the actual backend.

fixtures.scenario: Expanded alias dictionary contains untrusted PostgreSQL identifier text.
Allowed alias chosen by the application contains no forbidden backend syntax.

patterns.title: Django Q _connector
patterns.cause: A dictionary-expanded _connector selects SQL structural text.
preconditions: Untrusted dictionary controls Q _connector.
patterns.patch_observation: Q accepts only None, AND, OR and XOR connectors.
patterns.prevention: Q accepts only None, AND, OR and XOR connectors.
patterns.limitations: Normal filter values and structural connector names are different trust boundaries.

fixtures.scenario: Untrusted dictionary controls Q _connector.
Application chooses a connector from the explicit supported set.

patterns.title: Django MySQL MariaDB column aliases
patterns.cause: Untrusted alias dictionaries reach SQL generation on MySQL or MariaDB.
preconditions: Untrusted alias is passed through annotate, alias, aggregate or extra.
patterns.patch_observation: Alias checking additionally excludes hash SQL comment markers.
patterns.prevention: Alias checking additionally excludes hash SQL comment markers.
patterns.limitations: Backend and affected branch matter; historical regexes are not universal SQL sanitizers.

fixtures.scenario: Untrusted alias is passed through annotate, alias, aggregate or extra.
Application restricts aliases to fixed names and rejects backend comment syntax.

patterns.title: Django archive extraction common prefix
patterns.cause: String-prefix containment accepts an extracted filename in a sibling directory sharing the root prefix.
preconditions: Archive entry resolves into a sibling whose name shares the extraction-root prefix.
patterns.patch_observation: Archive containment uses os.path.commonpath and handles different Windows drives.
patterns.prevention: Archive containment uses os.path.commonpath and handles different Windows drives.
patterns.limitations: Normal archive children remain permitted; symlinks and filesystem races need separate analysis.

fixtures.scenario: Archive entry resolves into a sibling whose name shares the extraction-root prefix.
Resolved archive entry is a child according to path components, not string prefix.

patterns.title: Django FilteredRelation aliases
patterns.cause: FilteredRelation aliases bypass existing alias checking.
preconditions: Untrusted alias dictionary reaches FilteredRelation annotation.
patterns.patch_observation: add_filtered_relation checks the alias before adding it.
patterns.prevention: add_filtered_relation checks the alias before adding it.
patterns.limitations: Later PostgreSQL alias hardening is tracked separately as CVE-2025-13372.

fixtures.scenario: Untrusted alias dictionary reaches FilteredRelation annotation.
Fixed approved aliases pass the same validation as other annotation aliases.

patterns.title: Django Oracle HasKey JSON lookup
patterns.cause: Direct HasKey lookup accepts an unsafe left-hand expression on Oracle.
preconditions: Direct HasKey lhs is controlled by untrusted input on Oracle.
patterns.patch_observation: Oracle JSON path compilation preserves compiled lhs parameters instead of interpolating the lhs unsafely.
patterns.prevention: Oracle JSON path compilation preserves compiled lhs parameters instead of interpolating the lhs unsafely.
patterns.limitations: The ordinary __has_key path was reported unaffected; do not flag every JSON lookup.

fixtures.scenario: Direct HasKey lhs is controlled by untrusted input on Oracle.
Ordinary field-based has_key lookup retains compiler-controlled SQL and parameters.

patterns.title: Django JSONField values values_list
patterns.cause: Crafted JSON key text becomes a column alias through projection arguments.
preconditions: A JSON projection argument contains an untrusted alias-like key.
patterns.patch_observation: Projection fields receive the existing check_alias validation.
patterns.prevention: Projection fields receive the existing check_alias validation.
patterns.limitations: Specific to projections on models with JSONField in affected branches.

fixtures.scenario: A JSON projection argument contains an untrusted alias-like key.
An approved projection key is checked before SQL generation.

patterns.title: Django custom Storage save
patterns.cause: A custom storage override can omit inherited path validation.
preconditions: Custom storage overrides filename generation without preserving checks.
patterns.patch_observation: Storage.save validates names before and after get_available_name; separators are normalized for validation.
patterns.prevention: Storage.save validates names before and after get_available_name; separators are normalized for validation.
patterns.limitations: Built-in storage subclasses were reported unaffected; extension points can invalidate assumed guards.

fixtures.scenario: Custom storage overrides filename generation without preserving checks.
Storage validates the original and modified relative paths at the save boundary.

patterns.title: Django annotate aggregate extra aliases
patterns.cause: Expanded dictionary keys can become unsafe SQL aliases.
preconditions: Untrusted dictionary keys become column aliases.
patterns.patch_observation: Alias checking rejects quoting, whitespace, statement and comment syntax at annotation and extra boundaries.
patterns.prevention: Alias checking rejects quoting, whitespace, statement and comment syntax at annotation and extra boundaries.
patterns.limitations: Backend-specific later fixes are separate cases; value binding does not protect identifier text.

fixtures.scenario: Untrusted dictionary keys become column aliases.
Approved keys are validated as identifiers before compilation.

patterns.title: Django PostgreSQL explain options
patterns.cause: Expanded option dictionary names are interpolated into EXPLAIN syntax.
preconditions: Untrusted names are passed through QuerySet.explain options.
patterns.patch_observation: PostgreSQL EXPLAIN selects supported options and rejects invalid option syntax.
patterns.prevention: PostgreSQL EXPLAIN selects supported options and rejects invalid option syntax.
patterns.limitations: A query-plan option name is structural SQL, not an ordinary bound query value.

fixtures.scenario: Untrusted names are passed through QuerySet.explain options.
Application chooses supported EXPLAIN option names and boolean values.

patterns.title: Django Storage save returned path
patterns.cause: Filename separators and a storage-returned path can bypass expected confinement.
preconditions: Caller directly supplies a crafted filename to Storage.save.
patterns.patch_observation: Storage normalizes separators, validates the returned name and returns a path relative to the storage root.
patterns.prevention: Storage normalizes separators, validates the returned name and returns a path relative to the storage root.
patterns.limitations: Custom storage behavior and later boundary validation are tracked separately.

fixtures.scenario: Caller directly supplies a crafted filename to Storage.save.
Storage returns a validated relative child path after normalization.

patterns.title: Django admindocs TemplateDetailView
patterns.cause: Staff-selected template paths can escape configured template directories.
preconditions: A staff user supplies a path outside the template root.
patterns.patch_observation: TemplateDetailView uses safe_join before reading a template path.
patterns.prevention: TemplateDetailView uses safe_join before reading a template path.
patterns.limitations: File existence is exposed; contents require customized templates that display them.

fixtures.scenario: A staff user supplies a path outside the template root.
A staff template lookup remains confined to its configured root.

patterns.title: Django URLValidator IPv4 leading zeros
patterns.cause: Different consumers can disagree on octal-looking IPv4 literals with leading zeros.
preconditions: An IP-based access-control check sees an ambiguous leading-zero host.
patterns.patch_observation: Validators reject ambiguous leading-zero octets.
patterns.prevention: Validators reject ambiguous leading-zero octets.
patterns.limitations: Conditional SSRF/access-control bypass; Python version and validator path matter.

fixtures.scenario: An IP-based access-control check sees an ambiguous leading-zero host.
A canonical unambiguous IPv4 address is validated consistently by all consumers.

patterns.title: Django multipart upload filenames
patterns.cause: Multipart file names can contain path separators reaching custom upload handlers.
preconditions: A custom upload handler receives a user-controlled path-like filename.
patterns.patch_observation: Parser sanitizes unescaped filenames and removes Windows and platform path components.
patterns.prevention: Parser sanitizes unescaped filenames and removes Windows and platform path components.
patterns.limitations: Built-in upload handlers were reported unaffected; later filename hardening is a separate case.

fixtures.scenario: A custom upload handler receives a user-controlled path-like filename.
Custom handler receives a validated ordinary basename.

patterns.title: Django archive extract historical traversal
patterns.cause: Archive entry names can resolve outside the extraction destination.
preconditions: Archive contains absolute paths or parent-directory components escaping the target.
patterns.patch_observation: Historical patch canonicalizes target and filename then checks their string prefix.
patterns.prevention: Use the later commonpath-based component containment from CVE-2025-59682, not the historical raw string-prefix check.
patterns.limitations: The historical prefix check was incomplete; CVE-2025-59682 provides commonpath hardening.

fixtures.scenario: Archive contains absolute paths or parent-directory components escaping the target.
Use path-component containment for the resolved archive child, including sibling-prefix cases.

patterns.title: Django Oracle GIS tolerance
patterns.cause: An untrusted GIS tolerance is interpolated as SQL text.
preconditions: External text is supplied as Oracle GIS tolerance.
patterns.patch_observation: GIS tolerance becomes a Value expression and the function path validates numeric types.
patterns.prevention: GIS tolerance becomes a Value expression and the function path validates numeric types.
patterns.limitations: Oracle GIS context; preserving a numeric API parameter does not mean sanitizing arbitrary SQL.

fixtures.scenario: External text is supplied as Oracle GIS tolerance.
Tolerance is numeric and passed through the compiler parameter/value path.

patterns.title: Django PostgreSQL StringAgg delimiter
patterns.cause: An externally selected delimiter is directly interpolated into aggregation SQL.
preconditions: A download feature accepts an untrusted aggregation delimiter.
patterns.patch_observation: StringAgg wraps the delimiter as a Value expression.
patterns.prevention: StringAgg wraps the delimiter as a Value expression.
patterns.limitations: Normal delimiter choices must retain the intended aggregation behavior.

fixtures.scenario: A download feature accepts an untrusted aggregation delimiter.
The delimiter remains a compiler-managed bound value.

patterns.title: Django PostgreSQL JSONField HStoreField keys
patterns.cause: JSON or hstore key and index text is concatenated into lookup SQL.
preconditions: A dynamically expanded filter includes an untrusted JSON or hstore key.
patterns.patch_observation: Key transforms pass lookup keys as query parameters.
patterns.prevention: Key transforms pass lookup keys as query parameters.
patterns.limitations: Historical PostgreSQL field implementations; distinguish keys from full SQL expressions.

fixtures.scenario: A dynamically expanded filter includes an untrusted JSON or hstore key.
Lookup keys use SQL parameter binding while operators remain fixed.

patterns.title: Django SSI template include root
patterns.cause: A path with dot components can bypass an include-root check.
preconditions: Template include path contains parent traversal after an allowed root prefix.
patterns.patch_observation: SSI canonicalizes the filepath with abspath before include-root validation.
patterns.prevention: SSI canonicalizes the filepath with abspath before include-root validation.
patterns.limitations: Historical template feature; normalization alone is not a universal symlink or race defense.

fixtures.scenario: Template include path contains parent traversal after an allowed root prefix.
Normalize the path before enforcing a component-aware allowed-root boundary.

patterns.title: Django file session backend keys
patterns.cause: A session key can become a filesystem path with attacker-controlled separators.
preconditions: Cookie-derived session key contains a path separator.
patterns.patch_observation: File session backend restricts keys to hexadecimal characters.
patterns.prevention: File session backend restricts keys to hexadecimal characters.
patterns.limitations: File-backed sessions and platform separators matter; preserve valid session IDs.

fixtures.scenario: Cookie-derived session key contains a path separator.
Session key is restricted to the intended hexadecimal alphabet before path formation.

patterns.title: Django development admin media handler
patterns.cause: A URL-to-media-path conversion can escape the media directory.
preconditions: Crafted media URL resolves outside the expected static-file directory.
patterns.patch_observation: Media handler converts the URL path and applies safe_join to the configured media root.
patterns.prevention: Media handler converts the URL path and applies safe_join to the configured media root.
patterns.limitations: Historical development server; do not infer that current production static serving has this CVE.

fixtures.scenario: Crafted media URL resolves outside the expected static-file directory.
Translated media path stays inside its root or returns not found.

patterns.title: urllib3 PoolManager redirect disabling
patterns.cause: PoolManager retry handling can lose a redirect-disable protection.
preconditions: Application relies on PoolManager-level redirect disabling as an SSRF mitigation.
patterns.patch_observation: PoolManager normalizes retry settings and uses response retry state when no per-request override is present.
patterns.prevention: PoolManager normalizes retry settings and uses response retry state when no per-request override is present.
patterns.limitations: Requests and botocore default usage was reported unaffected; redirects are only one SSRF condition.

fixtures.scenario: Application relies on PoolManager-level redirect disabling as an SSRF mitigation.
Redirect behavior is disabled and verified at the effective request layer.
